meta.title: Fix ETag generation for streaming catalog entities endpoint
meta.body_summary: Add ETag generation to the streaming response path of the /api/catalog/entities endpoint to restore browser caching and reduce performance degradation on the catalog homepage.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot implemented ETag based on query params; maintainer identified that ETag must reflect response data; after multiple iterations, PR still closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 608 changed lines across 3 files, this is a medium-sized edit concentrated in backend router and tests. It fits a caching performance fix that was closed—not merged—due to unresolved design concerns about ETag being based on query params rather than response data.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer Rugvip commented twice that ETag can't be based on query parameters because underlying data may change, and must be based on response data. Copilot acknowledged and attempted fixes, but PR was closed without approval.
review_details.performance_claim: Restore browser caching via ETag to improve catalog homepage performance degraded by streaming response.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR without merge after iterative ETag fixes; no explicit rejection comment provided other than design concerns.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Implementing ETag for streaming response requires understanding that ETag must reflect response content, not request parameters. Copilot repeatedly based ETag on query or totalItem count, failing to meet the requirement until later fix, but still not merged.

detection_detail.code_reading: Rugvip read the PR and identified that the ETag was computed incorrectly (based on query params) without needing performance tests.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance data provided; tests verify ETag header presence and 304 responses, but not actual caching improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After multiple iterations, the PR remained unmerged and was closed without further comment.

core_change_summary.description: In plugins/catalog-backend/src/service/createRouter.ts, added generateQueryETag function and logic to set ETag header before streaming response, then revised to use entity metadata.etag values combined with query parameters. Updated tests in createRouter.test.ts and openapi.yaml.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file and schema updated to match new ETag implementation; no functional changes elsewhere.
change_trajectory: First implementation: ETag based on query parameters only.
Maintainer feedback: ETag can't be based on query.
Revised to include totalItems in ETag.
Further feedback: ETag must be based on response data.
Final implementation: ETag uses individual entity metadata.etag values.
Test and schema updates; PR closed without merge.

review_signals.summary: The ETag can't be based on the query since the underlying data may change.
The ETag needs to be based on the response data rather than the request parameters.
Acknowledged flaw and planned to include data state (totalItems).
review_signals.action_taken: Commit 4bdf1be updated ETag to include totalItems.

review_signals.summary: Fixed in eb927f1, now using entity ETags instead of query-only generation.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with query-based ETag.
Rugvip commented ETag can't be based on query.
Rugvip again stated ETag must be based on response data.
Copilot revised to use entity ETags and updated tests.
PR closed by Rugvip after 4 days of inactivity, no explicit approval.
